commands.name: list-connections
commands.summary: List connections (source -> destination pipelines) in the project, with optional name search and source/destination filters

commands.name: create-connection
commands.summary: Create a new connection along with a new WEBHOOK source and a new HTTP destination. Returns the source's ingest URL.

commands.name: list-sources
commands.summary: List sources (inbound webhook endpoints) in the project, with their ingest URLs

commands.name: list-destinations
commands.summary: List destinations (where events are delivered) in the project

commands.name: get-connection
commands.summary: Get one connection by id (web_...), including its source, destination and rules

commands.name: get-source
commands.summary: Get one source by id (src_...), including its ingest URL and auth config

commands.name: get-destination
commands.summary: Get one destination by id (des_...), including its URL, auth type and delivery policy

commands.name: count-connections
commands.summary: Count connections, optionally only those using a given source or destination

commands.name: get-event-metrics
commands.summary: Get event count metrics over a time range, optionally grouped by status or connection

commands.name: list-source-types
commands.summary: List supported source types (e.g. WEBHOOK, STRIPE, GITHUB) with their verification fields

commands.name: list-destination-types
commands.summary: List supported destination types (HTTP, CLI, MOCK_API, ...) and their auth options

commands.name: list-projects
commands.summary: List the projects (teams) the signed-in user can access; the id is the teamId used by other commands

commands.name: get-me
commands.summary: Get the signed-in user's profile, including the last-used project id
